task.title: Modernize remediation-analysis.yml to manual patch verification (remove general auto-repair)

problem.statement: The privileged remediation workflow ran broad, general-purpose auto-repair (mobile source sync, OpenAPI generation, dependency dedupe, ESLint --fix, go mod tidy, gofmt) across the whole checked-out tree before any verification, instead of the scoped task-based verification the progressive remediation system now provides. It predated wave P0 and was frozen, not modernized, while the foundation was built.

evidence.note: Formerly contained an 'Apply deterministic source repairs' step running mobile:apps:sync, openapi:generate, pnpm dedupe, nx lint --fix, go mod tidy, and gofmt -w before verification.

GAP-0002 recorded WORKFLOW_MODERNIZATION_REQUIRED with allowed_decision FIX_REQUIRED and the nine target files, blocked until wave P0-E closed and a real task passed through the new system (GAP-0003).

rootCauseHypothesis: The workflow was written before the progressive remediation system existed and combined auto-repair and verification in one privileged, secrets-free, manually-triggered job; now that scoped task-*.yml verification workflows and the orchestrator exist, the auto-repair half is redundant and inconsistent with 'no general auto-repair' governance, so it is removed and the workflow is renamed to reflect its narrowed, verification-only purpose.

current: remediation-analysis.yml ran mobile:apps:sync, openapi:generate, pnpm dedupe, nx lint --fix (full or affected), a go.mod-tidy loop, and gofmt -w across the whole checked-out tree before any verification step.
required: remediation-analysis.yml (BThwani Manual Patch Verification) verifies whatever is already at the requested source_ref — typically a task branch already repaired through the progressive remediation system — against the full logic, contract, build, test, database, security, and runtime gates, applying only the pre-existing policy-governed records cleanup.
forbidden: Reintroducing any general auto-repair step (mobile source sync, OpenAPI generation, dependency dedupe, lint --fix, go mod tidy, gofmt) into remediation-analysis.yml.
Breaking the marker set checked by required-command-integrity-gate.mjs, guard-registry-gate.mjs, or check-ci-source-immutability.mjs without updating all of them together in the same change.

acceptance.statement: remediation-analysis.yml no longer runs any general auto-repair step (mobile source sync, OpenAPI generation, dependency dedupe, lint --fix, go mod tidy, gofmt).
required-command-integrity-gate.mjs, guard-registry-gate.mjs, and check-ci-source-immutability.mjs (plus its unit test) all pass against the modernized workflow with a consistent marker set.
governance/github/workflow-registry.json and docs/ci-governance-required-checks.md accurately describe the modernized workflow's name, permissions, and no-auto-repair purpose.
